text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All done with today's training! I'm sooo
tired! And
sooo hungry!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's go eat, Trainer! I heard the chicken
meatball chanko they're serving today
has been simmering
since this
morning! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that really filled me up! The
meatballs were
so yummy and full of
miso flavor!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The rice soup we had to wrap up our
meal was
delicious, too... I'm fuller and
happier than
anything! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer! Did you know this is all
thanks to
you? It's really amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about how I can still enjoy my
food
after training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I heard you can lose your appetite when you get too tired.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But that never happens to me! Even
when I'm
super-duper tired, I can still
eat a whole lot and
enjoy it all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So I can concentrate on all kinds of stuff
now!
Because I know I'll be able to eat
till I'm full and
be happy when I'm done!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So... this means I've been training well,
right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure it does! See, I told you
this was all
thanks to you! ♪
choice_data_list: I'd be glad if that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for everything, Trainer! I'm going
to keep
eating lots and working hard! ☆
